# Ref: IRDAI/NUCIR/MISC/292/12/20-21 

# Date: 02-12-2020 

All Non-Life insurers (Including Stand Alone Health Insurers) 

# Re: **Mismatch in GDP flash Figures and Segment wise GDP figures total** 

It is observed that there is mismatch in GDP flash figures and Segment wise GDP figures total for some insurers. 

> Since data ~ maintained and collected in electronic format, there should not be any difference even small. 

Hence, insurers are advised to examine the reason(s) of differences (even small), if any, between submitted GDP flash figures and segment wise GDP figures total and communicate such reason(s) to us while submitting monthly business figures.
